text:
mara_marketing: quick ask — we need a compact bench & validation checklist for the launch post. marketing wants the raw numbers + a short reproducible run so we can link artifacts. can runtime run confirm what we can share and what's reliable?

sam_runtime: sure. what specific metrics do you want public vs internal? p50/p95/p99, coldstart heatmap, cost-per-1000 tokens?

mara_marketing: public: p50 + p95 + cost-per-1k tokens (quantized vs fp16). internal: full percentiles, variance, seed details, raw latency traces. also need the exact payloads & command to repro. audience will expect a short snippet they can run.

sam_runtime: ok. plan: we'll produce two artifact sets: launch-summary (public) + deep-artifacts (internal link). need: sample size (N), seed, warmup policy, and which quant modes. propose N=500 per slice, seed=42, warmup=100 requests, quant: fp16 + 4bit-quant. thoughts?

kai_bench: N=500 is okay for headline but add a randomized 5% holdout to validate. also include a small long-context tail (1% of runs at 8k tokens) to show degradation.

jess_pipeline: I'll host artifacts under gs://redwood-marketing/launch-bench-v3/ and set ACL to marketing:read for the summary. deep artifacts -> private bucket with short-lived signed URLs. I can auto-upload CI artifacts.

leo_product: for messaging — can marketing get a single sentence describing method: "median latency measured over 500 runs after 100 warmup requests; quantized numbers measured on 4bit static quantization"? want to avoid implied guarantees.

sam_runtime: yes. here's a minimal repro we can share (feel free to paste into docs):

```bash
# run on the perf cluster (example)
export BENCH_PAYLOADS=gs://redwood-marketing/launch-bench-v3/payloads.json
./tools/bench_run \n  --model redwood-open-7b \n  --iter 500 \n  --batch 8 \n  --warmup 100 \n  --seed 42 \n  --quant-modes fp16,4bit \n  --capture-traces gs://redwood-marketing/launch-bench-v3/traces/
```

sam_runtime: we'll attach a small JSON manifest that lists the actual payload filenames + slice labels (short, medium, long, api-like).

mara_marketing: great. timeline? we need the public summary + one example run link by EOD Tuesday to finish the landing page.

sam_runtime: can do a smoke run and upload summary by EOD Tuesday. deep artifacts next-day. I'll also include a p95 variance note: if p95 changes >12% vs prior run, flag it in the README.

kai_bench: add these sanity checks to the README:
- identical seed reproduces within 3% median variance
- warmup policy applied before sampling
- quantized run must use the same warmup steps as fp16
- holdout validation (5%) must be run last and kept separate

jess_pipeline: ok I'll wire up the uploads and create short-lived signed urls. tagging: marketing-summary.json (public) + runtime-deep-artifacts.tar.gz (private).

sam_runtime: one more: include the exact machine spec (GPU model, CUDA / driver, batch inner loop). I'll attach a small metadata.json.

deploybot: CI: perf-cluster/bench/1765439999 started https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/1765439999 :eyes:

mara_marketing: perfect — thanks all. once the summary is up i'll draft the launch blurb and ping legal for a quick check on claims. :rocket:

sam_runtime: ping me if legal needs the deep artifacts. I'll redact keys before sharing.

mara_marketing: noted. leaving this as the checklist: 1) quick repro snippet for docs 2) public summary (p50/p95 + cost) 3) deep artifacts (raw traces, percentile table, metadata) 4) 5% holdout and long-tail slice 5) upload + signed urls. thanks!
